additional_convergence_found_this_sessio: Sun et al 2007's Syt2-KO/calyx-of-Held finding is a SECOND, fully independent instance of the Geppert 1994 double dissociation -- different isoform, synapse type, technique, 13 years apart -- found only by forcing the search past the Schneggenburger-Neher 2000 paywall dead-end rather than accepting a one-shot gap (OODA orient step).

The n~1-2 'linear-ish' adversary is not a strawman: it is the field's own established description of a real, decorrelated release pathway (asynchronous release) per Sun et al 2007/Sudhof 2013 -- sharpening rather than merely asserting the specificity of the steep synaptotagmin-gated synchronous mechanism.

3 independent synapse types (frog NMJ 1967, retinal bipolar 1994, calyx of Held 2007) across 3 decades and 3 decorrelated techniques (EPP-amplitude titration, membrane-capacitance+uncaging, uncaging+genetic dissection) all converge on n in [3.78, 5.0] for fast/synchronous release.

Two independent groups (Schneggenburger/Neher; Bollmann/Sakmann/Borst), same year, same synapse type, different specific protocols, converge qualitatively on sub-millisecond pool depletion at similar (10-30uM) Ca2+ steps without being designed to match each other.
honest_gaps: Schneggenburger & Neher 2000's own exact in-paper cooperativity coefficient was not independently extracted (confirmed paywalled via NCBI abstract-only efetch + EuropePMC isOpenAccess:N/inPMC:N/hasPDF:N) -- the n~4-5 number used is sourced from Sun et al 2007 (independent later primary paper, same synapse type) and Sudhof 2013 (review, PMC full text mined directly), disclosed as a substitution, not asserted under Schneggenburger & Neher's own name.

Kd (Ca2+ affinity) is synapse-specific, NOT universal: 194uM (retinal bipolar, Heidelberger 1994) vs 38-44uM (calyx of Held, Sun 2007) -- a 5.1x spread, machine-computed and disclosed, not smoothed into one fabricated number. Only the cooperativity ORDER n is claimed as the cross-synapse-type universal.

del Castillo & Katz 1954's PMC full text is explicitly publisher-blocked from XML download (confirmed live this session) and Fatt & Katz 1952 is a pre-modern-abstract record -- their own exact quantal-content numbers (m, n, p) were not independently re-extracted; the modern quantal-framework numeric anchor used instead is Rosenmund & Stevens 1996 (RRP) + Schneggenburger & Neher 2000 (80% pool depletion).

The n-independent-site geometric derivation (Hill-equation joint-occupancy-probability model) is a disclosed SIMPLIFICATION -- synaptotagmin's real C2A+C2B sites are not perfectly identical/independent; the model is used only to derive the qualitative low-occupancy asymptotic-slope=n behavior, which is independently, directly confirmed by Dodge & Rahamimoff's own verbatim text (not a refit of the real structural binding scheme).

No raw electrophysiological trace or figure was reprocessed or eyeballed this session (figures are forensic-only per this repo's discipline) -- every gate reproduces either a paper's own directly-quoted summary statistic via closed-form arithmetic, a synthetic-data machinery validation, or a concordance/dissociation table built directly from verbatim-quoted findings.

All toxin/SNARE findings are in vitro/synaptosome/cultured-neuron preparations, not whole-organism dose-response -- the concordance gate is about specificity and mechanism, not a clinical LD50 model (out of scope here).
